gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-bhaiksuki: Wide, geometric, a little showy. Redux spaces its letters out, while Noto Sans Bhaiksuki packs in coiled, rounded lowercase that stays open and easy to follow line after line.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-brahmi: Contemporary in both fonts, though Redux leans on heavier verticals while Noto Sans Brahmi sits low with a high mean line and open curves. They share a page without fighting.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-buginese: Wide-set and confident, Redux enters every curve with a visible flourish and a gentle shift in stroke weight. Noto Sans Buginese is the quiet worker, its open letter mouths and short ascenders.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-buhid: Rounded, swelling curves give Redux a bold, spaced-out personality, and its enlarged lowercase fills the line. Noto Sans Buhid does the plain sans work, leaving generous gaps between curve ends and stems.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-carian: Noto Sans Carian keeps its terminals apart like open scissor blades, giving the text a tidy, professional look. And Redux sits above it with wide spacing and a slight pinch where curves meet stems.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-chakma: Redux enters each curve with a big, visible swoop. Noto Sans Chakma follows with lowercase packed up toward the caps and uncrowded s and c shapes, which keeps paragraphs inviting.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-cham: Rounded and wide, with sides that thicken slightly. Noto Sans Cham carries the text with tall, open-mouthed lowercase forms, so paragraphs feel friendly and unhurried.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-chorasmian: Spaced wide with a moderate stroke contrast, Redux brings a geometric swagger up top. Noto Sans Chorasmian is the plain sans below, with a large x-height and curves that stop short.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-coptic: Noto Sans Coptic builds a dense middle zone that dominates each line. Its open s and c keep that texture inviting, a quality Redux's comfortable thick-and-thin strokes echo above.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-cuneiform: Noto Sans Cuneiform has lowercase swollen like inflated glass beads, and its e opens up instead of closing. Redux's sturdy hairlines suit a generous size for the heading.
